name: Bear Electric Appliance Co.,Ltd.
summary: Bear Electric Appliance Co.,Ltd. is a Chinese firm dedicated to the development, manufacturing, and marketing of domestic electrical appliances. Operating under its 'Meng' brand, the company offers a diverse range of products, including yogurt makers, electric cooking devices, wellness pots, humidifiers, portable electric lunchboxes, egg boilers, and bean sprout cultivators. In addition to its retail channels, the company maintains its own e-commerce platform for product sales. Established in 2006, Bear Electric Appliance Co.,Ltd. is headquartered in Foshan, China.
